name: stowed

name: swing
evidence: 180 frames. r_hg02 and r_hg03 spin 179°, r_hg_f 152°. Frame 0 is the stowed prong. Played on bones 2.. only after the hand weapon is seated (bay shift frame 40, acmotion 280/281).
